description: This Java source file defines a Spring Security configuration class 'SecurityConfig' that sets up ACL-based security components, including permission evaluators, ACL services, cache, and user details management.

classes.name: SecurityConfig
classes.description: Spring configuration class that sets up security components including ACL permission evaluation, ACL service, cache, authorization strategy, and in-memory user details.

methods.name: expressionHandler
methods.description: Defines a bean for method security expression handling with ACL permission evaluator.

methods.name: aclPermissionEvaluator
methods.description: Creates an ACL permission evaluator bean.

methods.name: aclService
methods.description: Creates an ACL service bean using JDBC.

methods.name: lookupStrategy
methods.description: Defines a lookup strategy for ACLs.

methods.name: aclCache
methods.description: Creates an ACL cache backed by a concurrent map.

methods.name: aclAuthorizationStrategy
methods.description: Defines an ACL authorization strategy with 'ADMIN' authority.

methods.name: permissionGrantingStrategy
methods.description: Defines a permission granting strategy with audit logging.

methods.name: userDetailsService
methods.description: Provides an in-memory user details service with two users.
